name: agency-full
title: {label}: intelligence report as of {as_of}
objective: The {label} as a buyer: its organization, the money and the people at the offices that matter most, what each buys and from whom, what changed, what moved between forecast releases, who protested, and the topics it funds, for a reader building a plan to engage.

sections.title: What the record holds
sections.question: What was read, how many rows, how recent, and what is absent
required_parts: each domain with its rows and newest date
what is absent from this record

sections.title: What carries {focus}
sections.question: The statements, forecast rows and offices that carry the focus term
required_parts: how many statements carry the term and in which families
the offices that carry it most

sections.title: Where {office} sits
sections.question: The office's parent and siblings, who contracts for it, who leads it, with sources
required_parts: the chain above the office up to the agency
the contracting office that buys for it
who leads it, current or ended, with the source

sections.title: What {office} buys, in its own words
sections.question: The office's wiki page: what it buys or researches, quoted, and the notices read to it
required_parts: what it buys or researches, quoted
the notices or rows that say it

sections.title: Who holds the budget at {office}
sections.question: The budget lines and program rows placed in the office, with the basis of each placement, and what the lines name
required_parts: the lines placed in the office and the basis stated for each
enacted and request amounts as labelled
obligations this fiscal year where stated

sections.title: Who the record ties to {office}
sections.question: The people with a stated role at the office and the offices above it
required_parts: the source that ties them to it

sections.title: What {office} is buying now
sections.question: The office's open forecast rows and newest statements, its vendors, and the layers beside it
required_parts: open forecast rows or notices with identifiers
the top vendors on its awards

sections.title: Who holds the work at {office}
sections.question: The buying book of the office or the contracting office that buys for it

sections.title: Contracts ending at {office}
sections.question: The office's contracts that end within 18 months of the record's date

sections.title: What the top vendor at {office} did
sections.question: What the office's top vendor did in the 12 months before the record's date
required_parts: each move (award, notice, protest, new office) with its date and record

sections.title: What changed around {office}
sections.question: New or moved forecast rows, notices, topics and awards in the 90 days before the record's date

sections.title: What is said about {office}
sections.question: What leaders, Congress, the budget, oversight, conferences and news say in the office's chain
required_parts: each statement quoted with its date and family
which level of the chain said it

sections.title: SBIR and STTR topics carrying {focus}
sections.question: The topics that carry the focus term, by office

sections.title: SBIR and STTR topics at {office}
sections.question: The topics the office carries

sections.title: Who does {focus} work for the {short}
sections.question: The companies whose contracts show they do this work, as primes or teaming partners

sections.title: Bid protests
sections.question: GAO bid protests against the agency in the record

sections.title: Forecast rows that moved around {office}
sections.question: Rows whose award window or value moved between releases

sections.title: Requirements traced at {office}
sections.question: Each requirement of the office across forecast releases, notices and awards, from the built database
required_parts: notices and awards tied to it

sections.title: The requirements most time-critical on {as_of}
sections.question: The ranked requirements across the agency and the dates that make each one time-critical

sections.title: The week before {as_of}
sections.question: What changed in the week before the record's date
required_parts: each change with its date and record

sections.title: Next actions at {office}
sections.question: The next actions the temporal engine lists for the office's requirements
